senses.gloss: गल- + आपीड गल- + आपीड, m. strangling.
गल- + गण्ड गल- + गण्ड, m. 1. throat and cheek, MBh. 2, 902. 2. bronchocele, Lass. 94, 8.

1. गल् गल्, (akin to गुर्, cf. उद्-गुर्), i. 1, Par.
 1. To drop, to distil, Kathās. 11, 57.
 2. To fall, Śiś. 9, 75.
 3. To disappear, Bhartṛ. 1, 69.
 --Caus. गालय,
 1. To percolate, Daśak. 156, 2.
 2. To sift, Suśr. 1, 165, 18.
 3. To dilute, Suśr. 1, 166, 6.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To fall off, Śiś. 8, 34.
 --With आ आ, To fall, Rām. 5, 13, 34.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To tumble down, MBh. 1, 1409.
 --With उद् उद्, To burst forth, Bhāg. P. 1, 10, 14.
 --With निस् निस्, निर्गलित, Distilling, Ragh. 5, 17.
 --With परि परि, परिगलित,
 1. [] Tumbled down, MBh. 1, 1183.
 2. Sunk in, Pañc. 8, 17.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To distil, Prab. 79, 16.
 2. To fall off, Amar. 36.
 3. To disappear, Kathās. 7, 75. विगलित,
 1. Drained by distilling, MBh. 1, 1182.
 2. Liquefied, dissolved, Kathās 18, 78; Gīt. 1, 31.
 3. Tumbled down, MBh. 4, 826.
 4. Unwieldy, Bhartṛ. 3, 74.
 --Cf. गरुड, and Lat. volare (concerning the signification, cf. पत्), βάλλω (Causal).
† 2. गल् गल्, i. 10, Ātm. To distil; see 1. गल्.

† 3. गल् गल्, i. 1, Par. To eat.
 --Cf. 2. गॄ.

गल गल, i. e. 2. गॄ + अ, m. The throat, Pañc. 249, 1.
 --Cf. Lat. gula; O.H.G. kela; A.S. ceolr, etc..
गल्ल गल्ल (probably a dialectical form of गण्ड), m. The cheek, Pañc. 125, 9.
गलितक गलित + क (vb. 1. गल्), m. A kind of dance, Vikr. 68, 14.

गल्भ् गल्भ् (akin to ग्रभ्, see ग्रह्), i. 1, Ātm. To be bold.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, To behave resolutely, Śiś. 10, 18.
गल्वर्क गल्वर्क m. Crystal(?), Rām. 3, 48, 1.
† गल्ह् गल्ह्, i. 1, Ātm. = गर्ह्.
गालव गालव, m. The name of a saint, MBh. 1, 331.
गालवि गालवि, i. e. गालव + इ, patronym., m. A son of Gālava, MBh. 9, 2995.
गालि गालि, i. e. गल् + इ, 1. An execration, Bhartṛ. 3, 99.
गालिमन्त् गालि + मन्त्, adj. Using execrations, Bhartṛ. 3, 99.
गालोडय गालोडय, a denomin. (akin to the Caus. of गल्), Ātm. To examine.
गल- + चर्मन् गल- + चर्मन्, n. the throat, Suśr. 2, 215, 15.
गल- + द्वार गल- + द्वार, n. the mouth.
गल- + वार्त्त गल- + वार्त्त, adj. voracious, Pañc. iii. d. 95.
गलित- + विभव गलित- + विभव, adj. one who has spent his fortune (अर्थिषु, on the poor), Bhartṛ. 2, 36.
गल- + शुण्डिका गल- + शुण्डिका, f. 1. the uvula or the soft palate, Yājñ. 3, 98. 2. swelling of the kernels of the throat, Suśr. 1, 90, 16.

गल- + स्तन गल- + स्तन,
 I. m. a small fleshy process resembling nipples, hanging from the throat of some species of the Bengal goat, Pañc. iii. d. 265.
 II. f. नी, a she-goat.
गल- + हस्त गल- + हस्त, m. throttling, Kathās. 4, 68.
